title: Book Three · Chapter 172: The Fifteenth Morning
story:
Friday is Ronan's fifteenth morning under the summer agreement.

The bookcase customer is coming to collect his finished piece. Ronan finds the changed room plan, with the small card table still tucked inside.

The man comes before eleven. Mr Sun shows him the shelves while Ronan lays the plan beside them.

“That way round,” the man says.

He points to the table shape. Ronan turns the card to the position they chose on the first Friday.

The man nods and looks back at the bookcase.

“Room for the window.”

Mr Sun checks the last details and takes the payment. Another adult helps the man move the piece. Ronan keeps the path clear and gives the man his drawing with the receipt.

After they leave, he puts the remaining work papers in order. There is one short question for Mr Sun on top of the next customer's drawing.

At twelve, Mr Sun opens the pay book.

Five weeks. Three mornings each week. Fifteen mornings and forty-five hours altogether.

He pays the last nine yuan. Ronan has earned forty-five from this agreement. His work envelope will hold seventy-two now.

“A useful summer,” Mr Sun says.

“I learned a few English words too.”

“Keep learning those.”

Ronan thanks him and puts the pencil back. He takes his cloth and water bottle home. Dad stays for his own afternoon work.

After lunch, Ronan adds the last nine to the sixty-three. He writes seventy-two on the envelope.

The parents' one hundred and twenty and his older twenty and a half are unchanged. Together, the three amounts are two hundred and twelve and a half.

He puts the money away before he opens his application folder.

His teacher's note is inside. The form is filled in, and his own letter is ready. He reads the workshop paragraph once more and updates the completed days and hours.

Anna comes later with her four clean drawing copies. They spread them across the table while Mum finishes with a customer at the window.

Ronan can follow the same wall in both views. The stair sizes are clear. The fruit shop has its half-closed shutter and all the baskets beneath it.

“Four,” Anna says.

“Four.”

They put the drawings flat in her large envelope. Ronan puts his three pieces together in his own.

Mum comes over after the customer leaves. She looks at the two ready packets, then moves her cup to the other end of the table so the clean paper can stay dry.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

tuck＝夹好、塞在里面；position＝位置、朝向；update＝更新；unchanged＝没有改变的。

## 理解问题

1. 五周实际完成了多少个上午、多少小时、收到多少工资？三份已存钱合计多少？
2. 两人的材料各准备齐了什么？本章是否已经实际投邮或得到录取？

## 读句子

**He writes seventy-two on the envelope.**

拆开看：He / writes seventy-two / on the envelope.

他／写下七十二／在工资信封上。
